verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird ships free, self-serve generators built on Contract Express. Both use interactive step-by-step questionnaires: the SCC Generator assembles modular EU Standard Contractual Clauses and integrates with Docusign for paperless execution, and the German Term Sheet Generator produces term sheets for early financing rounds. Missing for 10: breadth beyond two narrow tools (EU SCCs and a simplified German-only term sheet), coverage of other founder documents, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how the tools work in practice.
